items.lede: Interim CEO Collette Kress sought to ease employee concerns following Jensen Huang’s ouster, in part by promising to increase compensation.
items.title: Inside Nvidia’s First Post-Jensen All-Hands: Pay Raises and More Equity

items.lede: Interim CEO Collete Kress reportedly offered staffers higher wages and more equity on an advanced schedule at the company's first all-hands after Jensen Huang resigned.
items.title: Nvidia promises employee pay raises, equity before December to quell unrest in wake of Jensen Huang scandal
